This is your chance to design for football’s biggest digital stage. Your work won’t sit in folders, it’ll live in feeds, stories and timelines across the globe.

YOUR POSITION ON THE PITCH

As freelance AI multimedia designer at 433, you will collaborate with our creative team to produce high-impact football content for our global audience. You’ll design content we share on our social media platforms such as 433, 433nl, 433esports, and WomenFC, covering everything from breaking news to banter, from memes to matchday magic.

We’re looking for someone who lives and breathes football. You know what kit drops today, what meme went viral yesterday, and what moment is about to blow up.

YOUR PLAYER PROFILE

At 433, we're looking for creative freelancers who can plug into a fast-paced, AI-enhanced content environment and deliver consistently high-quality work.

What we are looking for in a candidate:

  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Premier / After Effects);
  • Strong experience using AI tools (e.g. Higgsfield, Midjourney, DALL·E, Firefly, ChatGPT, etc.) to concept, iterate, and produce content at speed;
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment;
  • Ability to meet deadlines, working under pressure and a 24/7 mentality (also available in the evenings and weekends)
  • Creative thinker, familiar with telling stories in various visual formats, from video to static images.
  • Strong attention to detail, ensuring high-quality visuals and videos generated with AI tools
  • At least 3 years of experience creating football-related designs and concepts that clearly showcase your creative process
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Work within North American or European time zone


What We Offer

  • Freelance/contract-based collaboration (remote)
  • Work on high-visibility content seen by millions worldwide
  • Fast-moving, trend-driven creative environment
  • Direct collaboration with a global team that moves at the speed of football
  • Opportunity for ongoing work based on performance and fit
